card.name: Abbreviations and linking phrases in dose notes
card.fires_on: Short pieces that sit inside abbreviations, parentheticals, or list lead-ins, such as the period in "tr." or "Civ.", "e.g", the letter after a dose note, or "to" after "is equivalent".

modes.label: Abbreviation pieces
modes.description: The period or letters inside shortened forms like tr., Civ., Gk., e.g.
modes.example: Civ<<.>> Code of... more HEIR AT

modes.label: Equivalence and list wording
modes.description: Small words in phrases like "is equivalent to" or "trade names" before a drug or dose.

card.plain: It fires on little pieces of abbreviations and linking phrases, like "e.g." or "equivalent to", rather than on a medical idea.
